basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year Ph.D. candidate at HKUST NLP Group, working on natural language processing and machine learning. Research interests include LLM reasoning, VLM hallucination, LLM truthfulness, and interpretability.

work.name: MINIMAX
work.summary: Research intern working on machine learning and natural language processing at MINIMAX.

work.name: Tencent WXG
work.summary: Research intern at Tencent WXG Game AI Team, advised by Zifei Shan.

work.name: Shanghai AI Lab
work.summary: Research intern at Shanghai AI Lab, advised by Prof. Yu Cheng.

education.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
education.summary: Ph.D. student in the HKUST NLP Group, advised by Professor Junxian He.
Bachelor's degree from the Department of Computer Science and Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Graduated with Zhiyuan Honor Scholarship.

publications.name: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
publications.summary: First author. Synthesizing verifiable reasoning data at scale for learning logical reasoning. Co-authored with Yuanxiang Fan, Zhuo Jiang, Han Ding, Yongyi Hu, Chi Zhang, Yiqi Shi, Shitong Weng, Aili Chen, Shiqi Chen, Yunan Huang, Mozhi Zhang, Pengyu Zhao, Junjie Yan, and Junxian He.

publications.name: On the Perception Bottleneck of VLMs for Chart Understanding
publications.summary: First author. Investigating the perception bottleneck in vision-language models for chart understanding. Co-authored with Weihao Zeng, Xiwen Zhang, Yijun Wang, Zifei Shan, and Junxian He.

publications.name: On the Universal Truthfulness Hyperplane Inside LLMs
publications.summary: First author. Studying the universal truthfulness hyperplane inside large language models. Co-authored with Shiqi Chen, Yu Cheng, and Junxian He.

publications.name: In-Context Sharpness as Alerts: An Inner Representation Perspective for Hallucination Mitigation
publications.summary: Foundational co-author. An inner representation perspective for hallucination mitigation using in-context sharpness. Co-authored with Shiqi Chen, Miao Xiong, Zhengxuan Wu, Teng Xiao, Siyang Gao, and Junxian He.

publications.name: C-Eval: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models
publications.summary: Foundational co-author. A multi-level multi-discipline Chinese evaluation suite for foundation models at NeurIPS 2023. Co-authored with Yuzhen Huang, Yuzhuo Bai, Zhihao Zhu, Junlei Zhang, Jinghan Zhang, Tangjun Su, Chuancheng Lv, Yikai Zhang, Jiayi Lei, Yao Fu, Maosong Sun, and Junxian He.

publications.name: Composing Parameter-Efficient Modules with Arithmetic Operations
publications.summary: Co-author. Composing parameter-efficient modules using arithmetic operations at NeurIPS 2023. Co-authored with Jinghan Zhang, Shiqi Chen, and Junxian He.
